title: A land waiting for the landing lock queues behind the earlier waiter instead of timing out after 30 minutes while a later landing takes the lock
goal: Landings of several sessions on one clone take the landing lock in the order they asked, so a land does not end at step landing-lock after its 30 minute wait (BG-o4rrijqe and BG-mhlxillg each lost 30 minutes, while a later landing of another sprint took the lock first)

run: import sys; t=open("_tools/bl_land.py",encoding="utf-8").read(); ok="queue" in t and "ticket" in t; print(ok); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
